blocks.text: You can modify or delete an unmanaged database server as required.
To edit an unmanaged database server:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Service Registration.
On the Service Registration page, select the Unmanaged Database tab.
Do one of the following:
Click the Actions icon (), and select Edit for the required database server.
See image.
Click the name of the database server to go to the Unmanaged Database details drawer, then click Actions, and select Edit.
See image.
The Edit Unmanaged Database Server confirmation window appears.
In the Edit Unmanaged Database Server confirmation window, click Proceed to continue.
See image.
The Edit Unmanaged Database Server drawer appears.
In the Edit Unmanaged Database Server drawer, based on the selected database server type, update the following sections as required:
Cloud (for Cloud Database only): Update the cloud settings.
Database Server: Update the database server configuration.
Authentication: Update the authentication details.
Database Authentication (for Cloud Database only): Update the database authentication details (for HashiCorp Vault only).
See image.
Click Save.

blocks.text: The unmanaged database server is updated.

After updating, verify the connection between DSPM and the database server by running the test connection. For on-premises unmanaged databases, DSPM runs the test automatically after registration. For cloud unmanaged databases, like Snowflake and Databricks, you must run the test manually. To learn more, see Testing Connection for Registered Services.
Changes made to the database server configuration take effect only at the next scheduled scan.
To delete an unmanaged database server:

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > Service Registration.
On the Service Registration page, select the Unmanaged Database tab.
Do one of the following:
Click the Actions icon (), and select Delete for the required database server.
See image.
Click the name of the database server to go to the Unmanaged Database details drawer, then click Actions, and select Delete.
See image.
The Delete Unmanaged Database Server window appears.
In the Delete Unmanaged Database Server window, read the message, and then enter CONFIRM in the text box.
See image.
Click Delete Server.

blocks.text: The unmanaged database server is deleted from the Zscaler Admin Console.
